too_expensive.strategy: Reframe around cost of inaction and value received.
too_expensive.faq_angle: Why is this worth the investment?

no_time.strategy: Show speed, simplicity, and reduced implementation burden.
no_time.faq_angle: How much time does this take?

dont_trust_it.strategy: Use real proof, transparent process, guarantees, and risk reversal.
dont_trust_it.faq_angle: How do I know this will work?
